info.name: Bread and More API
info.description: Milestone 4 tests for the Bread & More bakery API (inventory, orders, special cakes). Set adminEmail and adminPassword in the collection variables, then run the folders in order (or use the Runner). Each request checks its status code.

item.name: 401 Login as admin with a wrong password
403 Staff tries the admin staff list
403 Staff tries to add a category
403 Staff tries to add a product
409 Delete a category that has products
400 Order with an invalid product id
400 Admin: complete a pending order (not allowed yet)
400 Accept before there is a price
403 Staff tries to set a price
400 Daily revenue with from after to
